exposure: Recommendation to undergo general or spinal anesthesia by non-medical staff
outcome: Preference for general or spinal anesthesia
Concerns and reasons for choosing anesthesia type
cohort: 813 pregnant women in Saudi Arabia undergoing elective cesarean sections
finding: Spinal anesthesia was preferred by more participants than general anesthesia, and this preference was associated with several factors including previous experience with anesthesia, education level, and non-medical advice.
